source: Restores the evolved forms R25 merged into base forms (original level, weight and settings from the pre-R25 backup) where the family is still in the live pool, plus dex-located evolutions of present families (settings copied from the family entry). The 卡修/卡修斯 boss line stays out of the wild. Shiny entries are rebalanced to about 5% each. Pets without map or battle resources are skipped; 科特1228 (no battle resource) is replaced on 拓梯星 by 科拉岩1229.

remove.reason: R55按图鉴加入，但资源树没有战斗资源；由同地点的科拉岩1229替代
